evidence.dur: 『If we cannot retain our existing users and expand our user base, the network effect provided by the social nature of our platform will diminish and the popularity of our platform and its profitability may be materially...』→堀の実体はネットワーク効果=dur85。ただし『diminish』表現が示す通り脆弱性を内包
evidence.dom: 堀セクションはnetwork effect1件のみで市場シェアの定量的優位を示すヒットなし。逆に『our market share may decrease』『lure away some of our users or reduce our market share』と競争劣後リスクが前面→hits根拠に基づき保守的にdom=50(競争的・支配証拠なし)。地域首位の可能性はあるが原本証拠なきため憶測回避
evidence.irr: ソーシャルアプリはマルチホーミング容易。ネットワーク効果でコミュニティ内摩擦はあるが『network effect...will diminish if users lost』が示す通り可逆的→代替容易寄り=irr50
evidence.rep: 技術的独自性の証拠なし。競合が『leverage their user bases and brand names to provide online social network and other products』とあり資本力ある競合が数年で複製可→rep35
evidence.erosion: 『our market share may decrease, and our business...may be materially and adversely affected』『new forms of mobile entertainment may emerge in the future and compete with our platform』→競争浸食が顕在化しつつある=emerging
evidence.disrupt: 『as user preferences evolve, new forms of mobile entertainment may emerge in the future and compete with our platform』→技術/形態代替の脅威が明示され未決着=unsettled(settledと言い切れない)
evidence.moatdecay: 売上は依然成長(rev 2024:339.7→2025:341.9、5年CAGR20.4%)、ネットワーク効果は現存→moatdecay=no。ただしerosion=emergingと競争激化で将来は要監視
evidence.expiry: 限セクションはUAEの特許/商標制度一般(『Trademarks are protected for a period of ten (10) years...renewed...indefinitely』)であり、当社の堀はコンセッション/特許束に依存しない→expiry=no(期限型独占ではない)
evidence.geopol: 深刻(3): (1)中国系運営×米上場の監査リスク『CAOB signed a Statement of Protocol with the China Securities Regulatory Commission...opening access for the PCAOB to inspect...firms headquartered in mainland China』(HFCAA/PCAOB), (2)中東紛争『heightened geopolitical tensions involving the United States, Israel and Iran, including direct and indirect military actions...increased the risk of a broader regional conflict』, (3)MENAの内容規制『regulations...may prohibit the display of content that...impairs the public interest, or is obscene...』, (4)Cayman法人『exempted company limited by shares incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands』で株主救済制約。複数の重大ベクトルが重畳→3
